## Decisions (recorded at implementation)

- **`@rhema/commands` is a new leaf package** (`packages/commands`, deps: `@rhema/contracts` only) —
  the ticket's "one grammar" pick. Browser- and server-safe: the palette model, the web island, and the
  api's `POST /runs`/`POST /estimates` all import the same parser/resolver; no React, no Node APIs.
- **Concurrency ruling landed as designed:** the PRB.21 guard moved from per-project to
  per-write-lock — `runs.lock_set` rows are compared via `firstConflict` (exclusive keys only;
  `draft:read:*` stays shared). Scoped readers discriminate their corr lock with the serialized scope
  (`corr:<draft>:<kind>:<k>:<scope>`) so `@section:III` ∥ `@section:IV` run in parallel while identical
  submissions still collide; writers keep `ns:write`/`draft:write` — exclusive, scope-free. No schema
  granularity was missing — no `D-P1.06-*` fallback row needed for it.
- **`words` scope kind** added for the §14.3 "first N words" trial offer (the covered slice renders as
  an explicit scope pill).
- **`blockedBy` replaces `activeRun` on the sheet**: `GET /projects/:id/run-sheet-context` computes the
  sheet's candidate lock set (workflow + scope) against non-terminal runs — the sheet shows
  "in progress" only for a real collision, not for an unrelated reader.
- **REQ-SPEC-17 sheet half**: the sheet renders the scope-approval consequence line (informational /
  blocking-2h / waits-for-you) and the api freezes `inputs.scopeBlocking` server-side (Full board or a
  protocol/venue change vs the project's pinned scope — never client-trusted). `gateContext` stays the
  run-task seam that reads it.
- **Editable scope facts**: the collapsed row's Protocol/Venue/Stage are real form fields; they freeze
  into `inputs.{protocol,venue,stage}` and drive `scopeBlocking`. `--wait`/`--auto`/`--budget`/`--rigor`
  levers preset the Approvals pick / cap / notch through the sheet query contract.
- **Cap editable upward only**, enforced twice: `min=` on the field + `Math.max(override, computed)`
  in `buildRunSheetView` and `Math.max(body, derived)` in the api.
- **The palette is GET-only**: every row resolves to `{kind:"sheet"|"navigate"|"disabled"}` — no row
  carries a POST; Enter navigates to `/p/:slug/run?…` and the sheet's Run button remains the only
  launcher (REQ-CHAT-25). Free-text search rides `GET /p/:slug/palette-search` → the api's project
  search narrowed to this project (hits deep-link: drafts → editor, letters → revision page).
- **All four grammar surfaces landed** (gap closed in the return pass): `packages/ide/src/menus.ts`
  holds the pure item models — `selectionMenuItems()` (§7.4's *Ask · Visualize · Fact-check · Review
  this section*, with *Line edit* + *Cut to length* resolving disabled-1.x through the grammar itself)
  and `contextMenuItems(vN?)` (the Timeline right-click menu, scoped `@vN` off `data-round`). The
  island (`ide.ts`) renders them in `.ide-cmdmenu` and resolves each `command` through
  `parseCommand → resolveCommand` — the same path the palette's typed row takes, so all four surfaces
  produce the byte-identical sheet GET (`menus.test.ts` asserts it). *Ask* is the free local action
  (opens the Desk's composer tab); the composer itself is P1.11's, consuming this same package.
- **Scoped dossier label landed**: `runs.scope` renders as scope pills beside the dossier's
  `versionLabel` (`dossier-routes` selects `scope`, `scopeChip` labels → `DossierDto.scopeLabels` →
  `DossierPage` pills). Dossiers were already keyed (version, run).
- **Promote-on-launch × idempotency interaction fixed**: freezing the working head at run creation
  broke the `Revise using your edits` stale-form dedupe (the re-POST could no longer resolve a
  `working` human_revision child → `not_a_human_revision` 409). `prep` now resolves a *frozen*
  human_revision child only when a fresh `revise-edits:<headId>` memo exists for it, so `createRun`'s
  memo check dedupes (200 `deduped`, never a second run) — an expired memo still 409s.
